title: Code of Alabama 1975, Title 27, Chapter 12 - insurance trade practices (unfair claim practices)
source_id: Ala. Code 1975, tit. 27, ch. 12 (ss 27-12-1 to 27-12-24 and following)
verified_how: Loaded s 27-12-1 ('Purpose of Chapter; Short Title', breadcrumb 'Title 27 Chapter 12'), whose text states the chapter regulates trade practices in the business of insurance by defining unfair methods of competition and unfair or deceptive acts. Also loaded s 27-12-24 'Refusal of Insurer to Pay or Settle Claims', which is live and forbids an insurer, without just cause, refusing to pay or settle claims with such frequency as to indicate a general business practice.
notes: The register's section view does not display the chapter caption, so the chapter name given here is descriptive. Claim-handling detail is largely in the Insurance Department's regulations (Ala. Admin. Code ch. 482-1-125), which are outside the statute.
